data.pr-body:
Bumps [path-to-regexp](https://github.com/pillarjs/path-to-regexp) from 3.3.0 to 9.0.0.
Release notes

Sourced from path-to-regexp's releases.

v9.0.0

Important: This release switches the package to ESM only and node >= 22. The primary incompatible API change is to switch ambiguous matches (2+ parameters in a segment) from the first being greedy to the last. For example:

const input = "/foo.json.html";
